title: A host line set just before a TermAl restart is lost: pending source-root lines are not persisted
outcome: A line the host has set for a session's holder but not yet delivered (EngramSessionState::pending_source_root_line, together with its delivery state) survives a TermAl restart and is delivered after it, so no check, credit or bind outcome is lost to a restart.
acceptance: A host line set just before a TermAl restart is lost: pending source-root lines are not persisted is done
